name: 场景转换一致性
description: Analyzes scene transition patterns for AI-generation artifacts.
useCase: Detecting AI-generated videos through scene gradient analysis
mechanism: Compares gradient distributions across frame quadrants to detect overly uniform scene structure that is characteristic of AI-generated content.
parameters: Block size: adaptive, Analysis region: face/body, Metrics: gradient energy, variance ratio
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated video artifacts
- Works across different video resolutions
- Complements other forensic analysis methods
- Low computational overhead per frame
limitations:
- Requires video input (not applicable to images)
- May produce false positives on heavily processed videos
- Performance varies with video quality
- Single-frame analysis limits temporal assessment

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Gu, Z. et al. (2022). Exploiting Fine-Grained Face Forgery Clues via Progressive Enhancement Learning. AAAI.
